notes.title: Thank you!
notes.notes:
Dear city builders fans. We are 3 days after release of Feudal Baron. More than 1k players have played the game already and we want to thanks too all fans for the support and reviews.

We just want to add that we heard a lot of comparing to the Manor Lords. But Feudal Banor is not competing with it. Manor Lords i huge and perfect game while Feudal Baron is just a new experiance for City Builders and medieval ages fans where you can a little chillout while exploring campaign with its story line or play, with easy to learn but hard to master, wit creating best city layout which will strive until become a new, medieval, prospering city.

We have been working on this game 3 last years with very small team of pasionates and we want to thank whole team for all hard work.

notes.title: Farm Manager World - Early Access in April on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40834893/c8edca37ae750d192f524c1b3f9f1880aad8bc1a.png[/img]

Hi Farmomaniacs! 
We are delighted to announce that our latest title in the series - Farm Manager World, will be available on Steam on April 29th, 2024! 

Add to your Steam wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2206350/Farm_Manager_World/

Why Early Access? 
You are a wonderful, committed community of players who have contributed a lot to the game in each previous edition. That's why we want to work closely with you over the next year to release the full version of the game in 2025 with your ideas and expectations in mind. We are already looking forward to working with you! ❤️ 

What will you find in Early Access? 
Prepare big mugs of hot coffee because we have prepared up to 2 campaigns in 2 locations for the launch: Europe and Central America, and 10 scenarios! 
In Farm Manager World, you will also be able to play some of the scenarios together with your friends! Each of you will have your farm and the goals will be accomplished together thanks to the resource exchange option. 

The upcoming updates will include fixes, your suggestions, and new locations - how many will depend on you - details will be coming soon. 

Warm greetings, 
Farm Manager World team

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Baron's Residence
notes.notes:
Greetings, noble rulers and determined city-builders,

I, your faithful Advisor, am delighted to report on the newest development of our thriving domain: the majestic Baron's Residence. As you know, this central structure represents not only the heart of our city but also the very essence of your rule.

The Baron's Residence is a testament to our city's growth and prosperity, evolving and expanding alongside it. This is not a simple, static building but a living entity that breathes with your city, changing and growing as your dominion does.

The wings, or extensions, of the Baron's Residence are far more than architectural embellishments. Each provides specific bonuses, invaluable aids to managing and developing our fair city. They are:
[list]
[*] Advisor's Wing
[*] Dungeon
[*] Knighthood's Wing
[*] Servants' Wing
[*] Stables
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40834893/392c91b045bce3bb796b2b76377bb2ba5fff0fa7.gif[/img]

The Baron's Residence is the epitome of your rule, and its progression stands testament to your skills as a ruler. Each wing you choose to add and develop further influences your city's future.

Always in your service,

Your Loyal Advisor

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Advisor
notes.notes:
Greetings, esteemed lieges and stewards of the realm, 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40834893/378f254d86f96ca6e1c1ce33cb3d6ab1f1001721.png[/img]

I, your humble and devoted Advisor, am honored to join you on your journey towards greatness in our ever-evolving game. As an experienced mentor, I shall be by your side, providing guidance through the complexities of kingdom management and sharing the wisdom I have acquired over the years. 

With matters of resource allocation or diplomatic relations, you can rely on me to offer invaluable suggestions, helpful insights, and crucial knowledge to aid you in your decision-making process. Together, we shall navigate the intricate web of choices that come with the mantle of a ruler. 

In my capacity as your trusted Advisor, I shall also meticulously track the progress of your kingdom, offering you periodic reports and updates to help you assess your realm's growth and development. Rest assured, I shall remain a reliable and relevant source of guidance throughout your rule. 

Thank you for allowing me the privilege of serving you, and may your kingdoms flourish under your wise rule. 

Ever at your service, 

Your Loyal Advisor

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Constructing buildings
notes.notes:
Greetings, noble vassals and stewards of the realm,

We are excited to share with you the latest feature we are working on. As you all know, building a thriving kingdom requires hard work and dedication, and now with the introduction of  stage based construction of buildings, players will have the opportunity to truly immerse themselves in the intricacies of managing their own kingdom.

With this new feature, constructing buildings has become a more involved and immersive experience. Each building requires a builder who must deliver the necessary materials to the construction site. As time passes and construction progresses, the next stage of the process becomes visible. Players will be able to see their buildings come to life, with several stages of construction looking different from one another.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40834893/e00b3a12f22b7673e19f3825a9e80edd4eb2a741.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40834893/cd759609965a7a66b710fa2474c50ed1ee9f75c7.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40834893/025ee01cd754899ccfefbeb0e6c3a866330e59dd.gif[/img]

To construct a building, players will need to gather materials such as stone, wooden planks, tools, logs, clay roof tiles, metal roof tiles, bricks, glass, iron, stained glass or bells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40834893/38f5794b3e642883c4177654cffb01c7ef7bb17f.png[/img]

These materials can be acquired through various means, such as trade, exploration or production, and players will need to strategically manage their resources to ensure that they have enough to construct the buildings they desire. We hope to provide players with a more immersive and satisfying gaming experience, allowing them to truly become the ruler of their own kingdom.

We welcome your feedback and suggestions on how we can continue to improve and expand upon the game. Thank you for your support, and we look forward to seeing your kingdoms grow and prosper.

Until we meet again,

The Feudal Baron Team.

notes.title: Feudal Baron is a medieval city builder where you play a rich middle man
notes.notes:
Sim Farm has unveiled Feudal Baron: King's Land, a medieval city builder where you're tasked with commanding and expanding an ol' city in the name of the sovereign. Doing that requires taking care of citizens' needs, designing a tax system, collecting the resources you need to grow, trading with merchants, and holding off invading forces.

Things don't start that big, though. The king hands you a small group of citizens, a modest settlement, and a challenge to gather the resources to grow your settlement in a way that keeps the locals satisfied. Accomplishing those goals is going to require heaps of gold. Not only will it allow you to expand your humble slice of the kingdom, but it'll keep the royal treasury satisfied, too. You can get plenty of it, though, by utilising collected materials to craft tools and weapons, selling them to various merchants.

That's not all you've got to worry about, either, as you need to defend yourself, too. You can do that by collecting goods to fortify your city so you can survive a siege. Oh, and you've also got to worry about fires, plague outbreaks, and rebellions - it's the medieval times, after all.

Read the rest of the story...
